summary: Davion Healthcare Plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting that a €30 million senior secured bond programme issued by subsidiary Davion Healthcare Finance Ltd was admitted to trading on the Vienna MTF on September 9, 2026, with a press release dated September 14, 2026. The five-year notes, commencing August 2026, carry a 10.5% fixed coupon, €100,000 denominations, ISIN GB00BTH2SB89, senior secured ranking, and intended acquisition-financing use. Admission does not confirm the full amount was subscribed, placed, or funded; proceeds deploy acquisition-by-acquisition with security over acquired assets. Watch for drawdowns and deal announcements, not a special-situation event.
